id: \G\bFor just $500, you can play the Safari Game.
en: \G\bFor just $500, you can play the Safari Game.
it: \G\bCon soli 500$ puoi partecipare al Gioco Safari.

id: \G\bYou can roam the wide-open safari and catch what you like.
en: \G\bYou can roam the wide-open safari and catch what you like.
it: \G\bPotrai girare liberamente per il safari e catturare ciò che vuoi.
\G\bSpiacente, i Box del tuo PC sono pieni.

id: \G\bWe only use a special kind of Poké Ball here.
en: \G\bWe only use a special kind of Poké Ball here.
it: \G\bQui usiamo solo un tipo speciale di Poké Ball.

id: \G\PN received 30 Safari Balls from the attendant. \se[itemlevel]\wtnp[20]
en: \G\PN received 30 Safari Balls from the attendant. \se[itemlevel]\wtnp[20]

id: \G\bWe'll call you on the PA when you run out of time or Safari Balls.
en: \G\bWe'll call you on the PA when you run out of time or Safari Balls.
it: \G\bTi chiameremo con l'altoparlante quando avrai finito il tempo o le Safari Ball.

id: \G\bWell, I'll wish you the best of luck!
en: \G\bWell, I'll wish you the best of luck!

id: \bAre you going to leave the Safari Zone early?
en: \bAre you going to leave the Safari Zone early?
it: \bVuoi lasciare la Zona Safari in anticipo?

id: \bPlease return any Safari Balls you may have left.
en: \bPlease return any Safari Balls you may have left.
it: \bRestituisci le Safari Ball che ti sono rimaste, per favore.

id: \bDid you catch your fair share? Come again!
en: \bDid you catch your fair share?  Come again!
it: \bHai catturato quello che volevi?  Torna a trovarci!
